findings.summary: REVOLVING DOOR: Bo Hines was Executive Director of White House Crypto Council under Trump, helped write the GENIUS Act (stablecoin regulation signed Jul 18 2025), resigned Aug 2025, immediately became CEO of Tether's new USAT stablecoin launched Jan 27 2026 — the exact product enabled by the law he wrote. Cantor Fitzgerald (Lutnick family) named as designated reserve custodian and primary dealer for USAT. This creates a direct pipeline: government official writes stablecoin law -> leaves government -> runs the stablecoin company -> Commerce Secretary's family firm profits as custodian.

Bo Hines (Robert Beauford Hines IV, b. Aug 29 1995, Charlotte NC) - Yale BA Political Science 2018, Wake Forest JD 2022. Former WR at NC State and Yale. Co-founded Nxum Capital/Nxum Group with father Todd Hines. Republican congressional candidate NC-13 (2022, lost) and NC-6 (2024, lost primary). Trump endorsed March 2022. FEC committee C00766162. FEC fined ~K for disclosure failures.

Nxum Group (co-founded by Bo Hines and father Todd Hines) donated M in pro-Trump billboard advertisements to MAGA Inc Super PAC one week before Nov 2024 election. Nxum portfolio includes Today Is America, an anti-woke media org targeting Gen Z where Hines served as CEO. Trump appointed Hines to lead crypto council in Dec 2024, taking office Jan 2025.

Bo Hines served as Executive Director of President's Council of Advisers on Digital Assets (White House Crypto Council) from Jan 2025 to Aug 9 2025 (~7 months). Led inter-agency working group (SEC, CFTC, Treasury, Commerce, bank regulators) meeting weekly on stablecoin standards. Produced 166-page policy report. Championed GENIUS Act through Congress — Senate passed 68-30 on Jun 17, House 308-122 on Jul 17, signed Jul 18 2025. The GENIUS Act created the regulatory framework enabling US-compliant stablecoins.

REVOLVING DOOR: Bo Hines resigned White House crypto council Aug 9 2025. By Aug 19 (~10 days later) he announced joining Tether as strategic advisor. On Sep 12 2025 Tether unveiled USA₮ (USAT) stablecoin and appointed Hines as CEO of Tether US division, headquartered in Charlotte NC. USAT is explicitly designed to comply with the GENIUS Act — the law Hines championed. Anchorage Digital (federally regulated crypto bank) is GENIUS Act-compliant issuer. Cantor Fitzgerald manages reserves. Hines went from writing the rules to leading the primary beneficiary in ~5 weeks.

ETHICS FRAMEWORK: Trump rescinded Biden ethics EO on Jan 20 2025 (EO 14148) and did NOT issue a replacement ethics pledge. Under statutory 18 USC 207, senior employees face a 1-year cooling-off on representational communications before their former agency. However, Hines role as CEO of a private company (not lobbying Congress/White House directly) may technically fall outside the narrow scope of 207. Biden-era pledge would have imposed 2-year ban on lobbying or representing before former agency — but Trump revoked it. The absence of any Trump ethics pledge creates a legal gap that Hines exploited.

TRUMP FAMILY CRYPTO CONFLICTS CONTEXT: Trump family operates World Liberty Financial (WLF) which issued USD1 stablecoin. WLF co-founders include Eric, Don Jr, and Barron Trump plus Steve Witkoff and sons. USD1 used in B Binance investment from Abu Dhabi MGX fund. Trump's TRUMP meme coin launched Jan 2025. Bo Hines as White House crypto council director was simultaneously advancing regulatory framework that benefited Trump family's own crypto ventures. No ethics recusal framework in place.

Bo Hines (Robert 'Bo' Hines, born 1995-08-29 in Charlotte, NC) — former college football player at NC State, Yale graduate, Wake Forest University School of Law. Republican political candidate for NC-13 in 2022 (lost to Wiley Nickel). Trump-endorsed. Appointed Executive Director of White House Presidential Council of Advisers on Digital Assets in January 2025.

Bo Hines served as Executive Director of the White House Presidential Council of Advisers on Digital Assets from Jan 20, 2025 to Aug 9, 2025 (7 months). He was a key architect of the GENIUS Act (Guiding and Establishing National Innovation for U.S. Stablecoins Act), signed into law July 18, 2025. Also helped implement Trump's Jan 23, 2025 EO on digital financial technology and the March 6, 2025 Strategic Bitcoin Reserve EO. Council held 1,000+ meetings with industry stakeholders.

REVOLVING DOOR: Bo Hines resigned from White House crypto council Aug 9, 2025. Within 10 days (Aug 19), Tether announced him as Strategic Advisor for Digital Assets & U.S. Strategy. On Sep 12, 2025, Tether unveiled USAT stablecoin and appointed Hines as CEO of Tether USAT division (age 29). USAT is designed specifically to comply with the GENIUS Act that Hines helped draft while in government. Headquarters in Charlotte, NC.

DUAL ROLE ETHICS ISSUE: After resigning as WH Crypto Council Executive Director, Hines remained as a Special Government Employee (SGE) to assist David Sacks (AI & Crypto Czar) with AI policy initiatives. This means Hines simultaneously held a government advisory role AND private-sector positions at Tether. SGEs are limited to 130 days/year but still subject to 18 USC 208 conflict-of-interest restrictions on participating in matters affecting their financial interests.

USAT CORPORATE STRUCTURE: USAT is a U.S.-regulated dollar-backed stablecoin by Tether. Anchorage Digital Bank (OCC-regulated, first federally chartered crypto bank) is the token issuer. Cantor Fitzgerald is the designated reserve custodian managing T-bill reserves. USAT Holdings Inc (FL corp P25000057870) was incorporated Oct 17, 2025, in St. Petersburg FL, officer: Serkan Yigit. Tether CEO Paolo Ardoino described it as targeting the US market under GENIUS Act framework. USAT launched Jan 2026.

CANTOR FITZGERALD-TETHER-LUTNICK NEXUS: Cantor Fitzgerald manages majority of Tether reserves (80B+ in Treasuries), acquired 5% stake in Tether for ~600M. Howard Lutnick (former Cantor CEO) served as Trump-Vance transition co-chair, then became 41st US Commerce Secretary. Lutnick 'vouched for Tether when few others would.' Cantor is now USAT's reserve custodian. This creates a triangle: Lutnick (Commerce Sec) -> Cantor Fitzgerald (Tether stakeholder/custodian) -> Tether/USAT (Bo Hines, ex-WH crypto czar). All parties benefited from the GENIUS Act framework.

SEC EDGAR: Bo Hines named as prospective director in Twenty One Capital Inc (ticker: XXI, CIK 0002070457) S-4 filing dated Sep 15, 2025 — 'CONSENT OF ROBERT BO HINES TO BE NAMED AS A DIRECTOR.' Twenty One Capital is a Bitcoin treasury company formed via SPAC merger with Cantor Equity Partners (CEP), incorporated in TX/DE. Also connected to Cantor Fitzgerald. Filing refs: S-4 (0001213900-25-087358), 8-K (0001213900-25-121293, Dec 2025), S-1 (0001213900-26-001285, Jan 2026).

DAVID SACKS CONFLICT PARALLELS: Bo Hines worked under David Sacks (WH AI & Crypto Czar), who received a financial conflict-of-interest waiver in March 2025 as an SGE. Sacks continues managing his VC firm while advising crypto policy. Elizabeth Warren and Senate Banking Committee launched ethics investigation into Sacks (Sep 2025). Sacks financial disclosure form never made public. Pattern: both Sacks and Hines had/have financial interests in crypto while shaping federal crypto policy.

GENIUS ACT POLICY CAPTURE: The GENIUS Act (PL 119-27, signed July 18, 2025) established the first US federal stablecoin regulatory framework. Key provisions: stablecoins must be 1:1 backed by USD/low-risk assets, issuers must be insured depository institutions or Fed-approved nonbank entities. Tether designed USAT specifically to comply with this framework — using Anchorage Digital (OCC-regulated bank) as issuer. Hines helped shepherd the Act through Congress, then became CEO of the company that most directly benefits from its provisions. The Act passed Senate 68-30 on Jun 17, House on Jul 17, signed Jul 18.

OPENSANCTIONS PEP DESIGNATION: Bo Hines flagged as Politically Exposed Person (PEP, role.pep) in OpenSanctions/Wikidata datasets. First seen 2025-01-17, last seen 2026-02-13. Known aliases: Robert Hines, Bo Hines. US citizenship. Political affiliation: Republican Party. No financial disclosure (OGE Form 278e) found in public search — this is notable for a senior White House official handling financial policy. LittleSis lists him as political candidate (entity 458975) and 'Bo Hines For Congress' PAC (entity 417015).

Bo Hines Revolving Door: White House -> GENIUS Act -> Tether CEO in 22 days. Timeline: (1) Jan 20, 2025: Appointed Executive Director, Presidential Council of Advisers on Digital Assets. (2) Jul 18, 2025: GENIUS Act signed into law -- stablecoin regulatory framework Hines shepherded. (3) Aug 9, 2025: Resigned from White House. (4) Aug 19, 2025: Fortune reports Tether hired Hines (10 days post-resignation). (5) Sep 12, 2025: Tether formally announces USAT stablecoin with Hines as CEO. USAT is explicitly designed to operate under the GENIUS Act framework Hines wrote. Anchorage Digital is the GENIUS Act-compliant issuer. Hines went from designing the regulatory framework to running the company that benefits most from it.

USAT-WLFI Tether Dual Stablecoin Architecture: Tether now operates two stablecoin products targeting US market: (1) USD1 via WLFI (Trump family venture, Eric Trump as Web3 Ambassador, used for MGX $2B Binance deal). (2) USAT via Tether USA, with Bo Hines (former White House crypto czar) as CEO, Anchorage Digital as GENIUS Act-compliant issuer, HQ in Charlotte NC. Both benefit from the GENIUS Act that Hines helped write. The person who designed the regulatory framework for stablecoins now runs the stablecoin company. This confirms Hypothesis H39 (Dual Stablecoin Regulatory Capture).
